units.source_text: 这一天正是九月底，红叶满林，浓淡相间，秋草经霜，斑驳多彩，好一片清秋美景啊！

en.t: It was just the end of the ninth month; the woods were full of red leaves, their shades mingling richly, and the autumn grasses, touched by frost, were mottled with many colors. What a beautiful scene of clear autumn it was!

units.source_text: 源氏公子一行人员从关口上出来，

en.t: Prince Genji and his party came out through the barrier gate,

units.source_text: 随从穿着各种各样的旅行服装，式样与花纹各尽其美。

en.t: and his attendants wore many kinds of traveling dress, each beautiful in cut and pattern.

units.source_text: 这群人物出现在这片秋景中，分外美观。

en.t: When this group appeared amid the autumn scenery, they looked especially splendid.

units.source_text: 源氏公子车上挂着帘子，

en.t: Curtains hung from Prince Genji's carriage,

units.source_text: 他从常陆介一行人员中召唤昔年的小君——现已身任右卫门佐——前来，

en.t: and from Hitachi no Suke's party he summoned the former Kogimi, who now held the post of Uemon no Sakan, to come to him,
and told him to carry this message to his elder sister Utsusemi:

units.source_text: “我今特来关口相迎，此心能蒙谅解否？”

en.t: I have come all the way to the barrier to meet you today. Will you understand what is in my heart?

units.source_text: 公子回思往事，感慨无穷。

en.t: The prince thought back on the past and was overcome with endless emotion.

units.source_text: 但此时人目众多，不便详说，心甚怏怏。

en.t: But with so many eyes upon them, he could not speak at length, and his heart was deeply troubled.

units.source_text: 空蝉也不忘那件隐秘的往事，暗想前情，独自悲伤。

en.t: Utsusemi, too, had not forgotten that hidden affair; remembering what had passed, she grieved alone in secret.
